name: Hamilton: The Dating Sim
source:
In this game, you play as Alexander Hamilton. You will help him navigate throughout the many social circles of the late 1700s. Throughout this journey, there will be many familiar faces like the Schuyler sisters, Aaron Burr, John Laurens, and many more.
[From [url=https://planettary.itch.io/hamilton-the-dating-sim] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款游戏中，你将扮演亚历山大·汉密尔顿，帮助他穿梭于18世纪末的众多社交圈。在旅程中，你会遇见许多熟悉面孔，例如舒勒姐妹、亚伦·伯尔、约翰·劳伦斯等。

（来源：[url=https://planettary.itch.io/hamilton-the-dating-sim]itch.io[/url]）
